description: This file implements a comprehensive verifier for Verifiable Credentials (VCs) and workflows, including functions for signature verification, integrity checks, security analysis, and compliance validation within a VC chain.

classes.name: EnhancedVCVerifier
classes.description: Main class providing methods for verifying VC chains, including signature, integrity, security, and compliance checks.

methods.name: VerifyEnhancedVCChain
methods.description: Performs comprehensive verification of a VC chain, including execution VCs, workflow VC, integrity, security, and compliance checks.

methods.name: verifyExecutionVCComprehensive
methods.description: Verifies a single execution VC with multiple critical checks, including signature and structure validation.

methods.name: verifyWorkflowVC
methods.description: Verifies a workflow VC, including signature validation and consistency checks with execution VCs.

methods.name: performIntegrityChecks
methods.description: Performs various integrity checks across the VC chain.

methods.name: performSecurityAnalysis
methods.description: Analyzes security aspects such as tamper evidence and key validation.

methods.name: performComplianceChecks
methods.description: Checks compliance standards like W3C and audit trail integrity.

methods.name: verifyVCSignature
methods.description: Verifies the cryptographic signature of a VC document using DID resolution info.

methods.name: validateTimestamp
methods.description: Validates that a timestamp string conforms to RFC3339.

methods.name: validateVCStructure
methods.description: Checks the presence of required VC fields.

methods.name: checkExecutionVCMetadataConsistency
methods.description: Ensures metadata consistency between execution VC and its VC document.

methods.name: checkComponentVCConsistency
methods.description: Checks consistency of component VC list with execution VCs.

methods.name: detectTamperEvidence
methods.description: Detects evidence of tampering in execution VCs.

methods.name: checkW3CCompliance
methods.description: Checks if a VC document complies with W3C standards.

methods.name: calculateOverallScore
methods.description: Calculates an overall verification score based on issues and security score.

methods.name: isStatusConsistent
methods.description: Checks if execution status values are consistent, considering system mappings.
